text:
Maya Li: Hey runtime team — can someone run a quick smoke + profiling sweep on Humbolt-6b (fp16 -> q4f16) for the onboarding checklist? Need p50/p95 token latency and steady-state throughput for 1k tokens, and a quick KV cache sanity. Target: Dedicated pool with 4xA4000. Thanks!
Evan Chen: taking this — starting a 15m steady state now. will post logs.
infra-bot: alloc request accepted: pool=dedicated-4a4000, job=humbolt-smoke-1768004321, ETA 2m
Evan Chen: smoke run done (no OOM). quick numbers:
```
config: batch=8, max_tokens=1024, threads=2
p50_token=6.8ms
p95_token=18.6ms
median_seq_latency(1k tokens)=6.8s
throughput=145 tok/s
GPU mem peak=9.1GB
```
Evan Chen: noticed token p95 spiky at tail when sequence len>512 — suspect attention kernel fallback on some layers.
Jia Patel: can you snapshot perf counters and nvprof flame? also please include KV hit rate for prefix caching.
Evan Chen: nvprof attached (link) — KV cache hit ~72% for the workload sample. attaching a small flame snippet:
```
kernel_miss_layer4 -> 24% of time
softmax_fallback -> 11% overhead on tail
```
Tom O'Neill: try lowering batch -> 4 and enable kernel selection override for fused-attn-v2, re-run p95 check.
Evan Chen: re-run with batch=4 + fused-attn-v2 override:
```
p50_token=7.1ms
p95_token=12.2ms
throughput=90 tok/s
GPU mem=8.9GB
```
Evan Chen: p95 improved a lot; throughput drop expected. For Dedicated SLA we said p95<=15ms, so this config passes.
Maya Li: great — please post a short YAML snippet for the rollout config we should publish.
Jia Patel: suggested rollout:
```
model: humbolt-6b
runtime_config:
  quant: q4f16
  batch_size: 4
  kernel_overrides:
    fused-attn: v2
routes:
  - pool: dedicated-4a4000
    min_replicas: 2
    autoscale: false
```
Maya Li: action items:
- Evan: upload perf traces + flame to onboarding doc (deadline EOD)
- Jia: add KV cache regression test to nightly bench
- Tom: validate fused-attn-v2 on the other 3 GPUs in the pool
Evan Chen: done — traces uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/bench/humbolt/1768004321
Jia Patel: I'll add the test to nightly. ping me if you want specific prompt sets.
Tom O'Neill: I'll run the validation tomorrow AM and report regressions.
Maya Li: thanks all. marking as ready-to-publish once Tom confirms. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: job humbolt-smoke-1768004321 finished: success (exit 0) duration 18m
